observations.says: at nine Dr. Mott was three miles off, in the sergeant's own sight
she knew the figure by the cloak, in the dark, not by its face
what she saw stands; that it was the doctor was her own conclusion, and it was wrong
the doctor drove out in his greatcoat, and the cloak he left behind was damp in the morning: someone else wore it in the rain
only Mr. Pell and Kitty, beside the doctor, could let themselves out at the side door
the cloak cleared the ground: on Kitty it would have trailed
